contentText:
Katherine Hamilton / Wall Street Journal :

Accelerant, which uses data analytics to connect insurance underwriters with risk capital partners, agrees to go private with Thoma Bravo in a $4.4B deal   —  The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027  —  Accelerant agreed to go private in a deal with private-equity firm Thoma Bravo worth more than $4 billion.
